subject.title: Dashboard: widget publish + community registry — the ecosystem half of the gallery

question: Should dashboard widget publishing and registry browsing be a bundled OpenClaw dashboard feature, a ClawHub/package-backed trust model, or an external experiment until the base dashboard stack lands?
rationale: The request creates a new dashboard distribution and trust boundary, and automation cannot choose the product/security model or whether this belongs in bundled OpenClaw.

options.title: Design ClawHub-Backed Registry
options.body: Keep this open and require widget publishing/browsing to use package-style trust metadata plus explicit widget approvals after the base dashboard stack settles.

options.title: Prototype Outside Core
options.body: Ask contributors to explore widget publishing as an external plugin or ClawHub package until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard distribution.

options.title: Defer This Direction
options.body: Pause the widget registry path if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to own a dashboard widget ecosystem surface now.

recommendation.title: Design ClawHub-Backed Registry
recommendation.body: Keep this open and require widget publishing/browsing to use package-style trust metadata plus explicit widget approvals after the base dashboard stack settles.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the current plugin-tab precedent and to VISION.md's ClawHub/plugin promotion guardrails, which are central to this product choice.
